Name: Pelican Town Event Expansion
Author: L0veRaven
Description:
This mod is just an excuse for me to treat the game like a dollhouse. Enjoy the stories I make for the characters (that should be compatible with canon lore).

Contains discussion of sensitive topics such as:
- Alcoholism
- Grieving the death of a loved one
